description:
As a SmartTools user, I want the Beacon report to retain my selected context when moving between report views, so that I can continue reviewing the same information.
Acceptance criteria:
Open the Beacon report from the V4 launcher.
Select a Beacon and a date range.
Move between the available report views.
Verify that the selected Beacon, date range, and displayed results remain correct.
Return to the original view and confirm the expected report is still shown.
